craft_claim: The denouement must provide emotional grounding and cathartic integration rather than rushed abandonment or over-explained exposition.

supporting_evidence.note: Field explains resolution as bringing the character to their new equilibrium so the audience understands the emotional aftermath.
Catharsis requires emotional purgation and cognitive balance following tragic turmoil.
Reunion on Hemakuta mountain establishes cosmic harmony before closing benediction.

exceptions: Cliffhanger episodes in serialized franchise media designed to withhold resolution for future installments.
